title: feat: allow buyer-selected x402 prepaid key amounts
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Lets buyers choose a prepaid amount from $0.01 to $10,000 using the existing x402 key route.
- Keeps existing pack URLs working and credits exactly the paid amount once.
- Documents the amount URL and tests exact quotes, invalid amounts, and replay-safe crediting.
- Adds no separate checkout fee; Weft currently advertises a $0.001 facilitator fee.

gist.headline: Pick your own pollen
gist.blurb: The x402 key route gets a dial instead of just preset packs: choose any prepaid amount from $0.01 to $10,000. The old pack URLs still work, and each payment credits its exact amount once.
gist.summary: The existing x402 key route accepts buyer-selected prepaid amounts from $0.01 to $10,000, preserves pack URLs, and credits the exact paid amount once with replay-safe handling.
gist.impact: Buyers can choose a precise prepaid amount without changing existing pack URLs or risking duplicate credit from a replayed payment.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the x402 key route as a cozy key dispenser with an adjustable dollar-amount dial beside familiar preset pack buttons. Polli turns the dial while a CRT monitor robot checks a receipt against a single glowing key; lime-green code-plants and flowers keep the scene warm.
